_comment: Single source of truth for the EDR launcher. Do not edit recipes: they are preregistered (CHANGELOG v1.26). Paths may be adapted to the local machine.

recipe_locked._ruling: v1.26: ablation arms are recipe-locked to rep2; the v1.0 'same grid' clause is void because A3 itself was not grid-selected.

a5._mode_comment: no_verifier_full = teacher outputs over ALL train-share failures, no V filtering at episode or sample level (the honest no-verifier counterfactual). Alternative mode repaired_episodes_only restricts the pool to the 74 rep2 episodes.

a6._dense_comment: dense_revision null = resolve the current commit hash at index-build time and freeze it into the index artifact (v1.26 ruling: model name + revision pinned in the frozen index).

a11._ruling: v1.27: three archived scramble seeds; an episode counts as placebo-rescuable if ANY seed's scramble passes V (union — generous to placebo = conservative for us). Main surface = heldout 158; train/val reported as reference.
